name: Scripture Filter
description: A text-format filter that turns Scripture references into links to online Bibles.
project_description:
This is a simple filter module. It converts a Scripture reference into a clickable link that points to one of numerous on-line Bibles.

 The default is the NIV in English on biblegateway.com's site. It can also use a number of other English translations from biblegateway.com, the ESV online bible and the NET bible.

 Please use the issue queue to help take the module forward - reporting any bugs you find, and requesting any new features you'd like to see.

 The Drupal 7 version will be maintained, with changes back-ported, for as long as Drupal 7 is supported.

 The 2.0.x branch is compatible with both Drupal 8 and Drupal 9.
